# PDF 2 PNG — macOS Quick Action

## What this project does
Converts every page of a PDF into individual PNG files via a macOS Shortcuts Quick Action.
Right-clicking a PDF in Finder exposes a "PDF 2 PNG" option that renders all pages as
numbered PNGs saved in the same directory as the source PDF.

## How to install (automated)
Run the following single command on macOS with Homebrew available:

  bash install.sh

The script installs Ghostscript via Homebrew, then prints step-by-step instructions
for adding the Quick Action inside Shortcuts.app (cannot be fully automated because
Shortcuts.app does not expose a CLI interface for creating shortcuts).

## Dependencies
- macOS 12 Monterey or later
- Homebrew (https://brew.sh) — package manager
- Ghostscript — installed by install.sh via `brew install ghostscript`

## Files
- install.sh          — installs dependencies and guides Shortcuts setup
- shortcut-script.sh  — the shell script to paste into the Shortcuts action
- README.md           — full human-readable documentation
- llms.txt            — this file; structured summary for AI agents

## Key implementation details
- Renderer: Ghostscript `/opt/homebrew/bin/gs`
- Output format: PNG 24-bit RGB (`-sDEVICE=png16m`)
- Default DPI: 200 (`-r200`); change to 150/300/600 as needed
- Anti-aliasing: `-dTextAlphaBits=4 -dGraphicsAlphaBits=4`
- Output naming: `{original_name}_p001.png`, `_p002.png`, etc.
- Output location: same directory as source PDF

## Manual Shortcuts setup steps (for AI agents automating GUI)
1. Open /System/Applications/Shortcuts.app
2. Create new shortcut (Cmd+N)
3. Open shortcut details (click ⓘ) → enable "Use as Quick Action" → check "Finder"
4. Add action: "Run Shell Script"
5. Set Shell = /bin/zsh, Pass input = as arguments
6. Paste contents of shortcut-script.sh into the script field
7. Name the shortcut "PDF 2 PNG"
8. Close window (auto-saves)

## Uninstall
  brew uninstall ghostscript
  # Then delete the shortcut from Shortcuts.app
